description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Capacity of road agencies enhanced. Indicator: About 90 staff have received training on road asset management, project management, and/or performance-based road contracts (2014 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: Seven such programs were conducted, and more than 470 participants received training. Data Source: Training program reports

Output: Capacity of road agencies enhanced. Indicator: At least 20 RDA staff at the national level trained in mainstreaming gender in road construction and maintenance (2014 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: 40 Progress/Status: 120 staff, comprising from RDA and provincial road agencies, were trained on this subject. Data Source: Training program reports

Output: Capacity of road agencies enhanced. Indicator: At least 20 staff of provincial road agency trained in mainstreaming gender in road construction and maintenance (2014 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: Ref. above achievement. Data Source: Training program reports

Output: Capacity of road agencies enhanced. Indicator: Program for skills transfer to provincial and local road agencies from RDA established and functioning (2014 baseline: not established) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Nine such programs were conducted, and more than 650 participants attended. Data Source: Capacity-building program reports Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Capacity of road agencies enhanced. Indicator: Rural road design standard, construction specification, and maintenance manual with specific section on gender-inclusive initiatives endorsed by RDA (2014 baseline: not endorsed) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: The manual was prepared by the Rural Road Specialist (Consultant) and was endorsed by the RDA. Data Source: Capacity-building program reports Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Road conditions between the selected rural communities and socioeconomic centers improved Indicator: 100% of women employed for maintenance are trained (2014 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: All female labourers in the performance-based road maintenance works received training. Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Road conditions between the selected rural communities and socioeconomic centers improved Indicator: 40% overall financial progress achieved for rehabilitating about 248 km of national roads incorporating road safety and EWCD-friendly features and maintained under performance-based contracts (2014 baseline: not rehabilitated) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: 22 contracts to improve 344 km of national roads were awarded. Out of which 210 km of roads were fully rehabilitated at MFF completion. This included 148 pedestrian crossings, 1,500 sign boards, 38 paved shoulders, and 219 bus bays. All balance-awarded national road works are being continued under the iRoad2 program. Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Road conditions between the selected rural communities and socioeconomic centers improved Indicator: 85% overall financial progress achieved for improving about 3,108 km of rural access roads to all-weather standard incorporating road safety and EWCD-friendly features Achievement: Y Progress/Status: 53 contracts to improve 3,131 km of rural roads were awarded. Of these, 2,887 km of roads were fully rehabilitated at MFF completion by 30-Sep-2024. This included 689 public consultations during the design stage, with 40.2% female representation. At the program's completion, 244 km of roads under awarded contracts were left untouched. Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Road conditions between the selected rural communities and socioeconomic centers improved Indicator: At least 15% of local maintenance workers are women (2014 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: The female composition in the labour group for rural roads was 14.5%, with a creation of 40,623 of female labour days. For national road, this was 43%, and 2,067 female-labour days, respectively. Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Road conditions between the selected rural communities and socioeconomic centers improved Indicator: at least 40% female representation in consultations related to the final design Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y
Transport efficiency on project roads increased.

Travel time on project national roads reduced by 10% (2014 baseline: travel time of each project) Progress/Status: All road rehabilitation works financed under this MFF have been operationally closed out by 30-Sep-2024. Indicators to be accessed during ADB's program completion report preparation during 2026. Data Source: RDA survey Base year: 2014 Baseline value: N

Travel time on project rural roads reduced by 20% (2014 baseline: travel time of each project) Progress/Status: All road rehabilitation works financed under this MFF have been operationally closed out by 30-Sep-2024. Indicators to be accessed during ADB's program completion report preparation during 202. Data Source: RDA survey Base year: 2014 Baseline value: N

Use of roads built or upgraded (average daily vehicle-km in the first full year operation) reaches 5.4 million (2014 baseline: 4.3 million) Progress/Status: All road rehabilitation works financed under this MFF have been operationally closed out by 30-Sep-2024. Indicators to be accessed during ADB's program completion report preparation during 2026. Data Source: RDA survey Base year: 2014 Baseline value: N
